title: Vegetarian Bibimbap Bowl
style: Korean-inspired rice bowl layered with sautéed vegetables, crispy tofu, and spicy gochujang sauce
description: A vibrant vegetarian take on the classic Korean bibimbap, featuring fluffy rice topped with sautéed mushrooms, fresh and wilted vegetables, crispy tofu, and a bold, spicy-sweet gochujang sauce.

items.note: traditionally Korean sticky rice; white or brown also works
baby bella, button, shiitake, or shimeji

steps: Cook Rice: Prepare rice according to package instructions. Keep warm.

Make Gochujang Sauce: In a bowl, whisk together gochujang, sesame oil, rice vinegar, water, soy sauce, sesame seeds, garlic, sriracha, and brown sugar. Taste and adjust sweetness, heat, or acidity as preferred.
Prepare Tofu: Press tofu between paper towels with a weight for at least 30 minutes until firm. Cut into cubes or strips and coat lightly with cornflour.
Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat. Pan-fry tofu 7–10 minutes, flipping until golden and crisp on all sides. Remove and set aside.
Prepare Vegetables: Toss cucumber with a little sesame oil, garlic, and salt. Set aside.
In a pan, heat 1 tsp sesame oil and sauté garlic briefly. Add spinach and cook until just wilted. Remove and squeeze out excess moisture.
Sauté mushrooms in sesame oil until golden and tender. Set aside.
Lightly sauté carrot, zucchini, and bell pepper until just tender but still crisp.
If using, fry egg in the same skillet to desired doneness with a runny yolk.
Assemble Bowls: Divide rice between bowls. Arrange vegetables and mushrooms in sections over the rice. Place crispy tofu (and egg if using) in the center.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and drizzle generously with gochujang sauce. Serve extra sauce on the side.
Before eating, mix everything thoroughly so the sauce coats the rice and vegetables evenly.
tips: Press tofu longer for a firmer texture and crispier result.
Keep vegetables slightly crisp to preserve texture contrast.
Adjust sugar in the sauce to balance spice from the gochujang.
For a vegan version, skip the egg and add extra tofu or sautéed mushrooms.
